g.text: Title: Zybo Z7-20 / Pmod JE / INMP441 array

g.text: Signal-level wiring; inspect breakout pad labels before assembly

g.desc: Signal-level wiring; inspect breakout pad labels before assembly

g.text: D +3V3 and GND are common rails. No 5 V, no tied SD lines, and no added clock resistors for the initial build.

g.desc: D +3V3 and GND are common rails. No 5 V, no tied SD lines, and no added clock resistors for the initial build.

g.text: E Labels of the same name are connected. R/C numbers match their microphone numbers.

g.desc: E Labels of the same name are connected. R/C numbers match their microphone numbers.

g.text: C Fit 100nF X7R directly across each module VDD/GND unless adequate local bypass is confirmed onboard.

g.desc: C Fit 100nF X7R directly across each module VDD/GND unless adequate local bypass is confirmed onboard.

g.text: B Fit one 100k SD-to-GND pull-down per independent SD unless an equivalent is confirmed onboard.

g.text: A Breakout terminals are identified by silkscreen; physical pad order and onboard components require inspection.

g.text: JE8 is unwired for the three-mic build.

g.desc: JE8 is unwired for the three-mic build.

g.text: 200 ohm series resistors are already on the Zybo JE signals.
